groups.name: Neon Hooks
groups.description: Immediate, memorable motifs with clear rhythmic identities.

groups.name: Midnight Sequences
groups.description: Pulsing figures and arpeggio-inspired movement, kept in the lead role.

groups.name: Cold Signals
groups.description: Minimal, angular phrases with clipped articulation and deliberate silence.

groups.name: Haunted Melodies
groups.description: Expressive minor-key themes, sustained notes, and bittersweet resolutions.

groups.name: Cinematic Flight
groups.description: Soaring phrases, wider intervals, rising tension, longer development.

patches.name: Neon Saw
patches.summary: One sawtooth into a resonant low-pass with a quick filter envelope.
recipe: Filter envelope: fast attack, 250 ms decay

patches.name: Hollow Pulse
patches.summary: Narrow pulse wave, high-passed, with a short gate for cold staccato.
recipe: High-pass near 180 Hz, low-pass near 3 kHz
Short release so rests stay silent

patches.name: Glass Triangle
patches.summary: Triangle with a quiet sine an octave up. Soft, close, vocal.
recipe: Triangle core plus sine one octave up

patches.name: Wide Unison
patches.summary: Two saws detuned by about 12 cents with delayed vibrato and a long release.
recipe: Two saws, plus and minus 6 cents

patterns.name: Chrome Horizon
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Rising octave-leap call on A4-A5 answered by a syncopated descending fifth-to-third hook; bar 3 expands to C6 before a G-major anticipatory pickup back to A4.
patterns.sound: Bright sawtooth lead with a restrained filter envelope.
patterns.performance: Delayed vibrato on sustained dotted-quarter notes (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Sunset Overdrive
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Punchy off-beat sixteenth-and-eighth synth hook built on F#4-C#5-F#5, shifting rhythmically on bar 2 and introducing a chromatic E#5 leading-tone tension in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Poly-style brassy mono saw lead with snappy amp attack.
patterns.performance: Subtle filter velocity sensitivity to emphasize off-beat accents (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Turbo Interceptor
patterns.borrowedChords: C (bVI borrowed from E natural minor)
patterns.motif: Driving E Dorian highway anthem highlighting the characteristic C#5 sixth degree in bar 3 before dipping to C-natural in bar 4 over the borrowed bVI chord.
patterns.sound: Dual-oscillator detuned sawtooth lead with medium resonance.
patterns.performance: Enable mono portamento around 25 ms for the bar-3 legato slide (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Laser Grid Rendezvous
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Compact 2-bar earworm pairing a tight dotted-eighth C5-G5-F5 call with an Ab-major ninth leap to Bb5 and a four-sixteenth turnaround.
patterns.sound: Hollow pulse-wave lead with a short release.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Magenta Arcade
patterns.borrowedChords: A (V major borrowed from D harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Playful syncopated synth-pop lead bouncing between D5, A5, and F5 before resolving through a dramatic C#5 harmonic-minor cadence in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Bright square-saw hybrid lead with chorus-friendly dry core.
patterns.performance: Slight mod-wheel vibrato on the final C#5 in bar 4 (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: VHS Heartbeat
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Nostalgic mid-tempo romantic lead built around a sighing minor-sixth leap (D5 to Bb5) with breathing space in bar 2 and a double-time sixteenth flourish in bar 3.
patterns.sound: Rounded triangle-based lead for a softer phrase.
patterns.performance: Gentle key-pressure or expression swell on long notes (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Starlight Boulevard
patterns.borrowedChords: F# (V major borrowed from B harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Expansive 8-bar synthwave chorus theme: bars 1-4 establish an ascending B4-F#5-E5-D5 hook, while bars 5-8 climb to B5 and resolve via an A#5 harmonic-minor leading tone.
patterns.sound: Sustained lead suited to subtle vibrato and spacious effects.
patterns.performance: Portamento glide (~30 ms) between B4 and F#5 leaps (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Electric Mirage
patterns.borrowedChords: A (bVI from C# natural minor), G# (V major from C# harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Sleek outrun hook exploiting the Dorian A#5 over F# major in bar 2, then pivoting to A-natural and B#4 (C5) over the borrowed bVI-V cadence.
patterns.sound: Thin, lightly saturated mono lead.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Cassette Rewind
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Bittersweet cascading triad motif that steps down through E5-B4-G4, replies with an upward sixth leap in bar 2, and finishes with an arched sixteenth-note sigh.
patterns.sound: Warm analog-style sawtooth lead with gentle high-frequency roll-off.
patterns.performance: Tape-style pitch warble on sustained half notes (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Cybernetic Lover
patterns.borrowedChords: C (V major borrowed from F harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Sultry nocturnal F-minor hook with syncopated anticipations on beat 4.5 and a dramatic E5 leading-tone resolution over the V chord in bar 4.
patterns.sound: PWM synth lead with moderate pulse-width modulation depth.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Grid Runner Pulse
patterns.borrowedChords: E (V major borrowed from A harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Foreground lead combining a driving sixteenth-note upper-pedal figure against a descending Andalusian bass-implied melody, culminating on G#5 in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Plucky sawtooth sequence lead with fast filter decay and bright bite.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Nocturne Telemetry
patterns.borrowedChords: Ab (bVI borrowed from C natural minor)
patterns.motif: Hypnotic 3+3+2 rhythmic sequence in C5-D#5-G5 that evolves across two bars of tonic before highlighting A5 (Dorian 6th) in bar 3 and Ab5 (borrowed b6) in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Crisp square-wave sequence lead with tight gate.
patterns.performance: Automate filter cutoff gradually upward across bars 1 to 4 (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Sodium Vapor Arpeggio
patterns.borrowedChords: C# (V major borrowed from F# harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Rolling sixteenth-note wave bursts separated by sustained melodic anchor tones, giving the illusion of a self-accompanying lead synth.
patterns.sound: Bright sawtooth lead with a restrained filter envelope.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Clockwork Autobahn
patterns.borrowedChords: B (V major borrowed from E harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Kosmische-inspired motorik eighth-note lead pattern with wide octave-and-fifth jumps that fracture into syncopated sixteenths in bars 3 and 4.
patterns.sound: Percussive FM-tinged analog lead with zero sustain pedal.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Phosphor Cascade
patterns.borrowedChords: none (V is native to G harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: 2-bar neoclassical dark-synth cascade in G harmonic minor exploiting the augmented-second jump between Eb5 and F#5.
patterns.sound: Harpsichord-edged pulse lead with crisp transient.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Cyberdeck Uplink
patterns.borrowedChords: none (Eb bII and Cm bvii are native to D Phrygian)
patterns.motif: Tense D Phrygian sequence pivoting between D5, A5, and the dark b2 degree (Eb5), before dropping into a syncopated C-minor answer in bar 3.
patterns.sound: Metallic resonant sawtooth lead.
patterns.performance: Slight filter-cutoff key tracking to brighten the A5-Bb5 peaks (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Velvet Tachometer
patterns.borrowedChords: F# (V major borrowed from B harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Propulsive compound-melody lead where low B4 anchor notes alternate with rising upper-voice melody notes (D5, E5, F#5, G5, A#5).
patterns.sound: Tight analog mono synth with fast envelope snap.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Orbital Relay
patterns.borrowedChords: D# (V major borrowed from G# harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: 8-bar evolving orbital sequence in G# minor: first 4 bars weave a tight fifths-and-fourths arpeggiated melody; bars 5-8 climb into the high octave and resolve via F##5 (G5).
patterns.sound: Glassy digital-analog hybrid lead with crisp attack.
patterns.performance: Subtle stereo ping-pong delay in DAW on eighth-note grid (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Shadow Transistor
patterns.borrowedChords: G (V major borrowed from C harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Darkwave-leaning sequenced lead with clipped staccato eighths, sudden sixth leaps, and a menacing B4-Ab5 harmonic-minor sting in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Hollow pulse-wave lead with a short release.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Neon Centrifuge
patterns.borrowedChords: F (bVI borrowed from A natural minor)
patterns.motif: Spiraling A Dorian sequence contrasting F#5 bright fourth-chord color in bar 2 against an F-natural modal shift in bar 3.
patterns.sound: Bright sawtooth lead with a restrained filter envelope.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Bunker Transmission
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Stark coldwave Morse-like motif in E Phrygian using clipped staccato eighths, wide minor-sixth leaps (E4 to C5), and tense F5 semitone stabs surrounded by multi-beat silence.
patterns.sound: Hollow pulse-wave lead with a short release.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Geiger Counter Waltz
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Mechanical 4/4 darkwave phrase using a cross-rhythmic dotted-quarter cold signal that fractures across the barline and exposes the D5-to-E#5 (F5) augmented second.
patterns.sound: Thin, lightly saturated mono lead.
patterns.performance: Bitcrush or sample-rate reduction optional for industrial texture (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Dead Channel 09
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Ultra-sparse 2-bar minimal-wave transmission with major-seventh and minor-ninth contour jumps (C4 to B4/Db5) and stark empty space.
patterns.sound: Cold narrow-pulse lead with zero vibrato.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Brutalist Concrete
patterns.borrowedChords: D (V major borrowed from G harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Rigid, architectural Post-Punk/Darkwave synth line built on fourths and fifths in the low-mid register (D4-G4-C5-D5), interrupted by sharp rests.
patterns.sound: Raw unfiltered square wave in lower-mid register.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Numbers Station
patterns.borrowedChords: E (V major borrowed from A harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Shortwave numbers-station motif repeating a three-note cell (E5-F5-A4) at shifting metric positions before breaking into a D#5/G#5 dissonant transmission in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Sine-triangle FM bell-lead with zero sustain tail.
patterns.performance: Bandpass filter between 400 Hz and 3.2 kHz for radio effect (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Fluorescent Morgue
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Glacial 88 BPM darkwave lead with a twitching 30-tick legato grace-note flicker (C#5->D5) followed by cold descending sixths and stark pauses.
patterns.sound: Thin, lightly saturated mono lead.
patterns.performance: Short 15 ms glide for the semitone flicker (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Subzero Conduit
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Angular, crystalline cold-synth line tracing diminished fifths and sixths over Fm-Db-Gdim-C with clinical precision.
patterns.sound: Glassy cold pulse-wave lead with steep high-pass filter.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Iron Curtain Echo
patterns.borrowedChords: A (V major borrowed from D harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Stoic 8-bar East-Bloc coldwave theme: sparse staccato calls in bars 1-4 answered by a higher octave surveillance variation in bars 5-8 with C#5 leading-tone tension.
patterns.sound: Hollow pulse-wave lead with a short release.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Null Pointer Pulse
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Jagged 2-bar cyber-minimalist loop locking onto B4, F#5, and the cold C5/G5 Phrygian bII dyad outline with off-grid sixteenth stabs.
patterns.sound: Sharp digital square wave with instant gate release.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Cryogenic Sleep
patterns.borrowedChords: D# (V major borrowed from G# harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Slowest pattern in Cold Signals (86 BPM): isolated, high-register ice-crystal notes (G#5-D#6-B5) separated by wide gulfs of silence.
patterns.sound: Rounded triangle-based lead for a softer phrase.
patterns.performance: Long hall reverb optional in DAW; dry phrase relies on wide register leaps (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Ghost in the CRT
patterns.borrowedChords: E (V major borrowed from A harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Elegiac minor theme opening with a sustained F5-to-E5 sigh over Am, descending through Dm and F before a poignant G#4-B4-E5 resolution.
patterns.sound: Sustained lead suited to subtle vibrato and spacious effects.
patterns.performance: Delayed LFO vibrato on sustained half notes (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Black Velvet Rain
patterns.borrowedChords: G (V major borrowed from C harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Weeping descending line in C minor that drops from G5 through Eb5 and C5, answers with an Ab-major ninth (Bb5), and sighs onto B4 in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Rounded triangle-based lead for a softer phrase.
patterns.performance: Soft aftertouch filter opening on long notes (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Sepulcher of Glass
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Gothic 8-bar darkwave elegy in F# harmonic minor: long singing phrases in bars 1-4 answered by an aching high-register variation in bars 5-8 descending from C#6 through A5, F#5, and E#5.
patterns.sound: Sustained lead suited to subtle vibrato and spacious effects.
patterns.performance: Portamento (~40 ms) on legato transitions (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Last Train from Wannsee
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Melancholic Berlin-school nocturnal melody using natural minor v (Bm) and iv (Am) to avoid dominant cliché, ending on an unresolved B4-C5-A4 suspension.
patterns.sound: Warm analog sawtooth lead with slow filter attack.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Cathedral of Static
patterns.borrowedChords: Bb (bVI from D natural minor), A (V major from D harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Bittersweet modal shift melody at 85 BPM: opens with the hopeful Dorian B4 natural over G major in bar 2, then darkens immediately to Bb4 in bar 3 and C#5 in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Rounded triangle-based lead for a softer phrase.
patterns.performance: Subtle pitch-env or vibrato on the bar-2 B4 -> bar-3 Bb4 contrast (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Porcelain Mask
patterns.borrowedChords: D (V major borrowed from G harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Fragile music-box-meets-darkwave theme featuring an ornamental sixteenth-note turn on beat 2 of bars 1 and 3 and a wistful F#5 resolution.
patterns.sound: Hollow pulse-wave lead with a short release.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Winter on the Spree
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Somber natural-minor theme keeping the v chord minor (F#m with A5 natural) for an understated, wintry European coldwave mood.
patterns.sound: Sustained lead suited to subtle vibrato and spacious effects.
patterns.performance: Slow filter LFO modulation (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Fading Polaroid
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Intimate 2-bar loop built on a major-seventh appoggiatura (C5 leaping to C6 and resolving to Db5/F5 over Db major7).
patterns.sound: Rounded triangle-based lead for a softer phrase.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Nocturne for Androids
patterns.borrowedChords: G# (V major from C# harmonic minor), D (bII Neapolitan borrowed from C# Phrygian)
patterns.motif: Cinematic Blade-Runner-inspired 8-bar nocturne: slow expressive leaps in C# minor that introduce a lush Neapolitan D-major bar (bar 7 with D5-F#5-A5) before resolving through B#4.
patterns.sound: Expressive CS-style brassy mono lead with long release.
patterns.performance: Channel aftertouch for vibrato and filter brilliance on sustained notes (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Ashes of the Arcade
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Haunted closing theme of Group 4: a nostalgic high E5-B5-G5 motif that gradually collapses downward over four bars to end on an exposed D#5 leading tone.
patterns.sound: Sustained lead suited to subtle vibrato and spacious effects.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Stratosphere Burn
patterns.borrowedChords: E (V major borrowed from A harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Heroic wide-interval ascent leaping a minor tenth (A4 to C6 via E5) in bar 1, soaring through D6 in bar 3, and resolving via a blazing sixteenth-note G#5-B5-E6-G#5 flight.
patterns.sound: Bright sawtooth lead with a restrained filter envelope.
patterns.performance: Mono legato portamento (~35 ms) for wide octave and sixth leaps (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Valkyrie Vector
patterns.borrowedChords: C (bVI borrowed from E natural minor)
patterns.motif: High-velocity aerial pursuit theme leaping across E4-B4-G5, contrasting C-natural in bar 2 (borrowed bVI) against the triumphant C#6 Dorian climax in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Dual-saw stadium lead with wide filter envelope sweep.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Hyperdrive Ascent
patterns.borrowedChords: C# (V major borrowed from F# harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Maximum-tempo (130 BPM) 8-bar cinematic showpiece: bars 1-4 build momentum through rising sixths; bars 5-8 erupt into octave leaps reaching C#6 and F#6 (MIDI 90) before an E#5 cadence.
patterns.sound: Bright sawtooth lead with a restrained filter envelope.
patterns.performance: Use mod wheel to open filter resonance during bars 5-8 (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Solar Flare Escape
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Urgent C harmonic minor flight theme combining wide seventh leaps (C5 to B5) with rapid sixteenth-note propulsive runs.
patterns.sound: Aggressive mono saw lead with resonant filter peak.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Andromeda Crossing
patterns.borrowedChords: Eb (bVI borrowed from G natural minor)
patterns.motif: Broad widescreen space-synth theme celebrating the G Dorian E5 natural in bar 3 before soaring onto Eb6 (borrowed b6) in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Sustained lead suited to subtle vibrato and spacious effects.
patterns.performance: Gentle expression swell across bar-long leaps (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Interceptor Afterburner
patterns.borrowedChords: A (V major borrowed from D harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Relentless descending-bass-implied heroic lead with upward tenth leaps in each bar and a blazing C#5-E5-A5-C#6 harmonic-minor climb in bar 4.
patterns.sound: Bright sawtooth lead with a restrained filter envelope.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Titan Skyway
patterns.borrowedChords: F# (V major borrowed from B harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Anthemic synth-rock lead soaring from B4 to D6 over four bars, using syncopated dotted-eighth hooks and a dramatic A#5 leading-tone resolution.
patterns.sound: Overdriven mono analog lead with singing upper harmonics.
patterns.performance: Pitch-wheel vibrato on the high D6 in bar 3 (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Eclipse Over Neo-Tokyo
patterns.borrowedChords: G# (V major borrowed from C# harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Cyberpunk skyline theme built on pentatonic-infused fourths and fifths that open into full diatonic and harmonic-minor (B#5) grandeur by bar 4.
patterns.sound: Bright sawtooth lead with a restrained filter envelope.
patterns.performance: none

patterns.name: Event Horizon Glide
patterns.borrowedChords: Bb (IV major borrowed from F Dorian), C (V major borrowed from F harmonic minor)
patterns.motif: Epic harmonic journey combining Db major (bVI), Dorian Bb major (IV with D5 natural), and C major (V with E5 natural) under a soaring octave-leaping lead.
patterns.sound: Sustained lead suited to subtle vibrato and spacious effects.
patterns.performance: 40 ms fingered portamento for octave and sixth glides (not encoded in MIDI).

patterns.name: Omega Dawn Finale
patterns.borrowedChords: none
patterns.motif: Grand 8-bar finale of the 50-pattern collection: synthesizes synthwave octave heroism and darkwave harmonic-minor tension, climbing to E6 before a decisive G#5-A5 cadence loop.
patterns.sound: Flagship dual-sawtooth + sub-octave mono synth lead with expressive filter sweep.
patterns.performance: Fingered portamento + mod-wheel vibrato on bar-4 and bar-8 climaxes (not encoded in MIDI).
